text: The write-once archive container is named rwb-docs-archive as a default: no source names it. The storage account, the immutability policy, the retention policy and the backup of the container belong to the platform storage product RWB-PLT-TE012-APP and are Not specified in the source documents; what this story owns is the file layout retention/YYYY-MM-DD/<table>/, the manifest with the row count and the SHA-256 per file, and the read-back before any delete. The standard containers rwb-docs, rwb-docs-legal and rwb-quarantine stay RWB-P5-E1024-APP's and are not written by this run.
